disclaimer.label: Important Notice:
disclaimer.body: Vettri Scheme Matching is an independent information platform and is NOT affiliated with the Government of Tamil Nadu or any government department. Scheme details are sourced from official government portals and updated periodically. However, scheme rules, eligibility criteria, loan limits and interest rates may change without notice. Users must verify all information on the official source portal before applying. Vettri does not guarantee eligibility, approval, or fund disbursement, and is not a lender, financial advisor, or government agent.

afford.title: Loan Affordability Calculator
afford.subtitle: Estimate whether you can comfortably repay a loan before applying for any scheme.
afford.empty_hint: Fill in the loan and income details to see your affordability estimate.
afford.disclaimer: This is an estimate only, not financial advice. Actual approval depends on the bank/NBFC and their own assessment.
afford.tip_comfortable: Your income comfortably covers this EMI. Safe to proceed.
afford.tip_manageable: You can repay this loan, but it leaves limited room for other expenses. Consider a slightly smaller loan.
